Root Cause & Empirical Data: Pilot agencies (MDDI ESG) left OTG because static forms could not capture role-specific questions. If 5-field flat builder feels too constrained agencies will revert to FormSG URLs.
Impact Description: Fragmented marketplace. Officers bounce outside CareerCompass; 90% drop-off persists.
Mitigation Strategy: Audit 10 recent FormSG gig forms across MDDI and PSD in Sprint 1 to verify 5 field types cover 90% of use cases. Secure executive posting mandate from PSD.

Root Cause & Empirical Data: 46% of gig postings draw 0 or 1 applicant despite near 1:1 total supply and demand. 69% of gigs post in Q2. Specialized roles sit invisible while officers flock to low-friction STIPs.
Impact Description: High poster churn. Frustrated hiring managers abandon the platform after getting zero applicants.
Mitigation Strategy: Enforce in-catalog sub-tabs inside Jobs and Opportunities (Projects & Rotations vs. Short-Term Immersions). Auto-tag unviewed gigs with Needs Talent after 7 days and push to targeted job family feeds.

Root Cause & Empirical Data: 89% of rotation outcomes go unrecorded because decisions occur offline in chats emails or spreadsheets.
Impact Description: Candidate limbo continues. Talented officers face weeks of silence fueling 90% candidate churn.
Mitigation Strategy: Introduce automated status reminder nudges to HR POCs at day 14 and day 28. Provide a 1-click bulk Send Polite Closure action to make closing postings painless.

Root Cause & Empirical Data: Agencies continue posting on internal intranets or legacy EDM blasts out of muscle memory.
Impact Description: Project halts at day 60 per Section 4 kill criteria.
Mitigation Strategy: Require the 6 pilot agency HR leads to commit to an exclusive CareerCompass posting agreement for pilot cohorts prior to Sprint 1 kickoff.

Root Cause & Empirical Data: Custom form builders are notorious time sinks. Drag-and-drop ordering complex validation and dynamic UI can consume 3 full sprints.
Impact Description: Delivery slips past Sprint 2. Core candidate roster and status tracking get squeezed out.
Mitigation Strategy: Hard-cap R1 form builder scope to 5 flat unbranched field types: Short text Long text Dropdown Checkbox Attachment. Ban conditional logic from v1.

Root Cause & Empirical Data: Discovery engaged HR POCs and DevOps admins but zero direct line managers. Assumes line managers will log in to screen candidates.
Impact Description: Line managers refuse to log into admin portal and demand that HR email them downloaded CVs anyway.
Mitigation Strategy: Run 3 rapid hallway usability tests with line managers from MDDI and ESG in Sprint 1 on a simplified read-only candidate dossier view accessed via authenticated magic link.

Root Cause & Empirical Data: Product Design and Engineering must align across four opportunity models (Project Gigs Immersions Rotations Jobs) in 5 sprints.
Impact Description: Design backlog stalls engineering; edge cases get discovered mid-sprint.
Mitigation Strategy: Run weekly trio sprint check-ins. Keep UI components shared across the opportunity models with unified layouts.

Root Cause & Empirical Data: Packaging 80+ candidate resumes into a single folder during peak panel reviews could cause slow browser downloads or frozen tabs.
Impact Description: Reviewers face delays and frustration during critical interview preparation.
Mitigation Strategy: Prepare the download bundle smoothly in the background and deliver an instant download link keeping the screen fast and responsive.

Risk Name: Candidate Data Privacy and Retention Standards
Root Cause & Empirical Data: Resumes contain personal career history and contact details. Keeping resumes indefinitely creates privacy and trust concerns.
Impact Description: Civil service data governance audit failure and loss of candidate trust.
Mitigation Strategy: Encrypt resumes securely and automatically archive files 90 days after hiring concludes ensuring candidate privacy and compliance with government standards.

Risk Name: Unverified Grade Integrity and Spam Submissions
Root Cause & Empirical Data: The friendly advisory warning against serial applications (H-APP-1) depends on matching job grade. If grade is manually entered candidates can alter it to bypass alerts.
Impact Description: Serial applicants continue submitting to mismatched roles (e.g. 1 candidate filing 112 applications) overwhelming review panels.
Mitigation Strategy: Pre-fill candidate grade directly from verified login identity with a clear limit of 5 active open applications per officer at any one time.

Risk Name: File Upload Safety Checks and Processing Speed
Root Cause & Empirical Data: Direct resume uploads require safety checks to protect against corrupted or unsafe files.
Impact Description: Files get delayed in review; review panels cannot view candidate resumes promptly.
Mitigation Strategy: Automated safety checks run quietly upon upload with clear status badges (Uploading
Target Milestone: Ready). Reviewers can see candidate profile details immediately while file safety is confirmed.

Root Cause & Empirical Data: Pilot agency HR posts across both legacy channels and CareerCompass resulting in duplicate candidate submissions across forms and Compass.
Impact Description: Administrative confusion and duplicate candidate reviews. Candidates receive conflicting status updates across systems.
Mitigation Strategy: Filter out pilot agency postings from legacy sync. Agree on clean cohort-based cutover where pilot programs post exclusively on Compass with zero retrospective migration.
